value.title: Codex seats: register on spawn, reply as themselves
value.summary: pij-fleet#76: Codex seats spawned by pij-rs never register, and their pij send replies arrive as another seat. Reproduce live on main first, fix only demonstrated causes, prove on recorded captures.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Reported 2026-10-26 by the osk-central prime (report: ~/osk/osk_central-governance/.harness/government/reports/2026-10-26-codex-spawn-defect.md, pij-fleet#76). On main 26fc3ba with codex-cli 0.164.0: (1) `pij-rs spawn --harness codex` times out waiting for registration (30s and 120s) in three governments although the Codex TUI is healthy; earlier seats stayed session null and needed a trust prompt answered. (2) Replies sent with `pij send` from Codex seats are attributed to other seats (two reviewers both arrived as one seat; another arrived as a parentless seat). Plan 177 (#66) recently changed Codex footer parsing, so the cause may be new, old, or in Codex itself: this plan diagnoses before it fixes. Rulings: assets/rulings.md.

sections.name: goals
value: A Codex seat spawned by pij binds, or fails with an error that says why.
A Codex seat's messages carry its own id, or refuse.
Every fix rests on a captured, reproduced cause.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Changing tmux capture or control mode (PR #73 owns that).
Claude, Copilot, OMP or Pi bind paths.
Fixing #65 generally beyond what Codex identity needs.

value.claim: Diagnosis before any fix. On main 26fc3ba the coder reproduces BOTH defects live and records, in assets/evidence/diagnosis.md: the exact spawn commands, the spawn log, `pij state`/`pij list --json` rows for each canary, the daemon's bind/registration events for it, raw pane captures at 0s, at the timeout, and after the TUI settles, and the Codex rollout/session files. For each defect it names the root cause with the observation that proves it (file:line in pij and the captured input it mishandled), and says whether plan 177 (dcfed3d) changed the outcome. If a defect does not reproduce, it records that and the conditions tried (fresh untrusted worktree, trusted folder, quota warning on screen, two Codex seats in one cwd, a pane id reused after the 2026-10-26 reboot) and does not fix it (ruling R2).

Registration. A Codex seat spawned with `pij-rs spawn --harness codex` binds (session non-null, `pij state` shows it bound) within the spawn timeout in the conditions that failed in ac-0001. Where Codex itself blocks binding (for example its folder-trust prompt), the spawn either gets past it the way pij already handles Claude's trust dialog, or fails with a named error that says what is on screen, never a bare 'timed out waiting for registration'.

Identity. `pij send` from a Codex seat is attributed to that seat, including when another Codex seat shares its cwd and when its pane id was used by an earlier seat. When a Codex seat cannot derive its own identity, the send refuses with a named error instead of sending as another seat. The derivation follows the root cause in ac-0001; it uses the seat's own process/pane/session evidence, never a cwd or most-recent-registration guess.

Footer misread. A non-footer line containing `·` and a `/`-word (the observed `⚠ 5h limit: 49% left · resets at 12:33 AM on 27 Oct · /status`, and the `← for agents · ? for shortcuts … ⚠ 2 warnings · f2 to view` hint line) is not parsed as a Codex footer by crates/harnesses/src/composer.rs parse_codex_footer, so it cannot supply a model of `⚠` or a cwd of `/status`. Recorded fixtures from ac-0001's captures pin model, cwd, readiness and composer recognition for the 0.164 layout with and without a session title and with the warning lines present.

Docs. docs/how/pij-pane-signals.md (Codex section) and the Codex part of docs/how (spawn/bind) describe what binds a Codex seat, how a Codex seat knows who it is, the trust-prompt behaviour, and the new named errors. skills/pij says nothing contrary.

Proof. Every behaviour change has a test RED on main 26fc3ba (quoted) and green on the branch, built from the real captures in ac-0001 (no invented pane text). Mutation receipts: revert each fix one at a time; its test turns red; restore. cargo test (scoped to the touched crates), clippy -D warnings and fmt pass; GitHub CI green on the exact head. The prime's post-merge live canary (spawn a Codex seat, it binds, its `pij send` arrives under its own id) is recorded in assets/reviews/prime-verification.md. Anything not run is NOT RUN with its reason.

value.title: Diagnose and fix Codex bind and identity
